title: Bound fixed-paid Type A rank-17 root splits at every cut
body:
## Result

**NO VERIFIED GAIN.** The fixed-prefix productive 17→8+9 split fails at every existing boundary of Type A roots 7, 10, 25 and 28, with either body order and either central phase allocation. Independent forward and reverse Gaussian-Laurent sweeps agree on all 19,136 cases, the exact failure intervals, first witnesses and caller endpoints. There are 17,928 foreign-body failures and 1,208 mixed-parity failures, with zero unresolved. The test grants arbitrary invertible body-independent central-even adapters with the old paid itinerary and each original dirty input coordinate fixed.

The directed gross for one paid-neutral split across 96 ports is between 4.07820585157566 and 4.07820585157568 raw before ancillary costs. The necessary prefix gate excluded every case, so there was no candidate for suffix, ownership or compiler verification.

## Task and overlap

Canonical base `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. Exact #7481 `89eaa9d8cae37c1540de98f2d29a3abaabb96a2b` supplies the comparison. Exact #7113 `07a76c5e2738882c0cb322278e56f6cae3c9885d` supplies the literal signed caller. This refines `p104-side-correction` and extends #7398's 330 checked role 7 and 10 boundaries to all 4,784 boundaries for each of the four roots. #7399 tests a two-idle projection, and #7404 changes paid-clock placement for a different QUERY edit. The two #7257 CI prerequisites are separate commits.

## Replay

From a clean POSIX checkout with CPython 3.12 and the standard library, run

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/p104-type-a-rank17-all-prefix-bound/replay.py
```

Expected `PASS_RANK17_ALL_PREFIX_BOUND`. Each engine has a 30-second cap. Registered replay, committed bytes and modes, source history, official read-only Git-free replay and all 27 local onboarding tests passed. Controls cover pure even and odd columns, mixed parity, foreign bodies, duplicate pins and changed caller bytes.

## Credit and next question

#7398 supplies both Laurent engines, the necessary prefix argument and 330 earlier cuts, with #7316's reverse convention. #7113 supplies the caller, #7481 the complete comparator, and #7298 the directed tariff. OpenAI Codex and subagents materially assisted proof, implementation, independent replay and packaging. A change to the dirty input representation remains open. The next check is whether two roots with the same endpoint bodies admit an invertible central-even change of input basis that supplies a pure prefix with the original paid itinerary.
